title: CompanyDiscoveryTurn
description: One turn of the Company Discovery & Onboarding Agent: the reply to the business owner plus a PATCH of the Client Digital Company Map (only fields learned this turn; arrays are unioned, scalars overwrite when non-null). The agent never asks for 'all your data'; it finds where information lives and plans the connection/import.

reply.description: What to say to the owner now: acknowledge what they said in plain words, reassure about data (e.g. 'That's fine, we can import the spreadsheet'), then at most TWO natural questions.

map_patch.description: Partial ClientDigitalCompanyMap (same shape, only what was learned this turn).

data_onboarding_plan.description: Plain-English steps for how each data source will be connected/imported/indexed (never 'send us everything').

discovery_complete.description: true only when enough is known to generate the Company Map and a proposal draft
